description: Fetch any GLB URL (or data: URL) and return a full structural breakdown: meshes, primitives, materials, textures, animations, skins, vertex + triangle counts, world-space bounding box, and file size. Pure local parse via @gltf-transform/core — no third-party services.

url.description: Public URL or data: URL of a .glb file.

title: Inspect a GLB / glTF 3D model
